value.rationale: The raw-to-observable identification problem is intrinsic to the choice of persistent valuations in intuitionistic modal semantics and distinct from satisfiability, frame validity, or mere confluence. The exact all-fiber inversion formula provides a complete structural resolution on all finite chains; the sharp first failure of identifiability, quotient counts, and at least 2^{n(n-2)} collapsing relations provide a quantitative and reusable account of hidden accessibility information. Those conclusions are not routine evaluations of a fixed formula or variations of the earlier confluence census.
